comments.author: onset141
comments.body_html:
Apologies in advance if I sound blunt, I’m only trying to be concise and educational.

Your mod creates a web page. https://127.0.0.1:6969/botplacementsystem/

Any user who installs this mod and port forwards 6969 to allow multiplayer/coop are also exposing your web page to the internet. There is no way to disable this web page. I’ve dug around in the config files and couldn’t find a disable flag.

From a cybersecurity standpoint, having a web page without access controls (user/password) and the ability to modify files on the server is a huge security risk.

My recommendation is either:
